description: Return the committed, transport-neutral capacity routing order. With schema_version 2 this lists PROVIDERS (never accounts) by descending score, each with every offered model's own quota standing: status (available, unknown = no current sample, priority_overflow, exhausted, no_eligible_account), best_priority, evidence (fresh, stale, missing), newest_observed_at (sample age), and exhausted_until, plus config_revision, capacity_revision, and ranked_at (the advice clock, not sample age). Optional exact model filter keeps providers offering that model, ranked by it. Read-only: no quota collection, reservation, or start. Choosing provider, model, effort, and profile stays with the caller.
name: capacity_order

description: List enabled runtime model rosters with capability and health evidence. With schema_version 2 this is the revisioned provider catalog: config_revision, capacity_revision, roles_sha256, canonical profiles with their grants, and providers in capacity order with harness, connection kind, recommendations, and every explicit model offering (native_model, default params, allowed_params, hard restrictions, recommendations, admissible profiles, cached quota standing with evidence and sample age). Providers are ranked over only the offerings the filters retain. Reuse a result only while config_revision, capacity_revision, and roles_sha256 all match. Optional exact provider, profile, and model filters; unknown values are validation errors. Read-only over current config, roles, and committed observations; recommendations are configured prose, not a ranking. The caller alone chooses provider, model, effort, and profile.
name: models

description: Read current fresh capacity readings without projections.
name: limits
